subject.title: fix: remove systemSent guard from dashboard session auto-title genera…

question: Should the canonical fix preserve first-turn semantics explicitly, or intentionally allow previously untitled historical dashboard sessions to be titled by a later message?
rationale: Deleting `systemSent` fixes the reported first-message block but also removes the only current history guard; selecting the intended persisted-session behavior requires an explicit ownership decision between the two open implementations.

options.title: Preserve explicit first-turn semantics
options.body: Prefer the approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108263 or equivalent rework here, after adding real dashboard proof for new and historical sessions.

options.title: Allow later historical titles
options.body: Keep this deletion only if maintainers intentionally want any unnamed historical dashboard session to acquire a title from its next eligible message.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit first-turn semantics
recommendation.body: Prefer the approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108263 or equivalent rework here, after adding real dashboard proof for new and historical sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: The dashboard session API history makes this the strongest available owner for deciding lifecycle and persisted-title semantics.
